0022600102.text: The LA Clippers (1-0, 1st in the Pacific, 2nd in the West) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (1-0, 2nd in the Pacific, 4th in the West), with both teams unbeaten and having won their only game so far at home. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Lakers list Adou Thiero (knee), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), Collin Sexton (calf), and Jake LaRavia (ankle) as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting a 125-122 Clippers loss in Los Angeles on February 20, 2026.
